jobs.title: Supply Chain Finance, Sr. Analyst (Fixed term 1 year)
jobs.location: EMEA · CHE · Stabio · VF Campus VF1
jobs.description:
VF Corporation is hiring a Supply Chain Finance Sr. Analyst (Fixed term 1 year contract) to join the Supply Chain Finance team based in Stabio, CH.

Let’s talk about the role!

As part of the EMEA Supply Chain Finance team, the person will collect and analyse financial and Supply Chain information to support effective decision making. The role will contribute to the preparation, development and analysis of Supply Chain costs, providing reliable support to Supply Chain Finance Management and Supply Chain Operations teams across planning and controlling activities.

The position will play an important role in ensuring continuity and quality in the team’s day-to-day forecasting and reporting processes, supporting the analysis of cost trends, variances and business performance across the assigned perimeter.

The ideal candidate holds a post-secondary education (Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering or a related field), has experience in business controlling, and combines strong analytical skills with a precise and collaborative approach.

The main responsibilities of the role include:

- Support the team in month end/quarter-end forecast and budget activities across the assigned Supply Chain cost perimeter;

- Prepare financial analysis and planning information related to product cost, including purchase price variance, logistics, freight and duty expenses;

- Support the analysis of variances across the four European Distribution Centres, focusing on variable and fixed costs such as supplies, depreciation, occupancy, temporary and fixed labour;

- Support the analysis of variances within the Customer Service area;

- Analyse, reconcile and prepare reports to inform management of variances versus forecast, plan and previous year;

- Contribute to the roll-out of Supply Chain projects and support the team in related financial activities.

Skills for Success

- Education: University degree in Finance or Engineering

- Experience: Proven experience in financial business analysis, preferably in cost controlling

- Language skills: Fluent in English, both spoken and written

- Technical skills: Strong knowledge of computer systems (MS Office suite), with particular emphasis on reporting tools, including BPC

- Soft skills: Precise, responsible, proactive and communicative, with strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently when needed

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

- 50% discount on all VF brands

- Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

jobs.location: EMEA · CHE · Stabio · VF Campus VF1
jobs.description:
Timberland EMEA is looking for an exceptional Developer, Apparel , to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s Talk about the Role

As a key member of our Product Development team, you will provide insights and suggestions and share information to deliver quality products on time at the right cost for the intended performance use. Your work will be performed under general guidance and direction, which may require the initiation of contacts to resolve and discuss mutual problems or collaboration on procedures or transactions. Infrequent overseas development travel may be necessary.

How You Will Make a Difference

- Develop product across multiple genders by product category depending on the seasonal style count and expertise.

- Participate meetings and execute against the Product expectations for product quality, cost (predictive costing)

- Own Product specifications, measurements, BOM, Fit creations and maintenance.

- Communicate effectively and clearly with Asia sourcing & vendors, TD/ GPC / GSP

- Collaborate w/ design & merch to support the line plan through product execution and signing of for bulk production.

- Hit required product creation milestones and execute on strategy

- Work w/ Global Product costing team in VFA and internal merch/ design teams on seasonal FOBs to support Gross margin growth.

- Be an engaged and committed team-mate, Be a facilitator in negotiations.

Skills for Success

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

- The ability to work with cross-functional teams, including Consumer Research, Research and Development to compile and evaluate research on future product requirements and identify enhancements to current products

- The aptitude to help the Product Development team establish strategies ranging from product pricing, design, marketing, advertising, packaging, and future products to manage the product family's life

- An understanding and knowledge of Timberland’s principles, practices, and procedures

- The resourcefulness to determine a course of action based on guidelines and modify processes and methods as required

- The capability to resolve issues which are often varied and non-routine
- Apply previous experience to identify the most appropriate option or improve existing approaches

- Seek clarification when needed

- Undertake analysis and investigation to solve differing, but related, problems

- The talent to convey complex information to occasionally divergent audiences that may require some persuasion
- In some instances, audiences are not knowledgeable of the subject matter

- Or an objective review of difficult work problems, obtaining cooperation or approval

While formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in a few years of experience and professional achievements.

What’s in it For You

-
A supportive, feedback‑based culture guided by respect and integrity.

-
An inclusive, international environment where diverse backgrounds and experiences are valued.

-
The opportunity to be part of an iconic lifestyle brand within a global, multi‑brand organization.

-
On‑site gym with health and well‑being initiatives.

-
A discount card offering 50% off all VF brands.

-
Break‑out areas with complimentary hot drinks.

About Timberland

At Timberland, we’re a force of nature. We’re a team that steps outside, works hard together, and moves the world forward. The brand is widely recognized as the arbiter of boot culture. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and an eye toward the future, Timberland has a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and build community.

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As a purpose‑led, performance‑driven company, we foster a culture of belonging based on respect, openness, connection, and authenticity. We celebrate diversity and support equal opportunities for all associates and applicants.

If this sounds like you and you’re ready to join our team, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for a highly skilled Antitrust and Regulatory Compliance Counsel to join our Legal team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role

This role plays a critical and specialized role in strengthening VF’s global Antitrust Compliance Program, with a primary focus on Europe and close alignment with global initiatives.

As a recognized antitrust expert, you will lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of VF’s antitrust compliance program framework across EMEA, and act as a key advisor to legal and business stakeholders on competition law risks arising from wholesale and distribution activities.

Alongside this core mandate, you will contribute to VF’s broader global Ethics & Compliance program, supporting the long-term evolution of the role into a wider Ethics & Compliance leadership position for EMEA and APAC.

This role reports to the Vice President, Ethics & Compliance.

Key responsibilities

Antitrust Compliance

- Lead VF’s European Antitrust Compliance Program, ensuring a robust, risk-based framework aligned with global standards.

- Serve as the go-to expert on competition law for EMEA wholesale and distribution activities.

- Identify, assess, and mitigate antitrust risks arising from:
- Distribution models (selective, exclusive, hybrid)

- Pricing practices, discount policies, and commercial strategies

- Interactions with wholesalers, retailers, and competitors

- Provide practical, business-oriented advice to legal and commercial teams on complex competition law matters.

- Design and deliver targeted antitrust trainings (live and online), tailored to business realities.

- Lead or support internal investigations, dawn raid preparedness, and incident response.

- Monitor legal developments across jurisdictions and translate them into clear, actionable guidance for stakeholders.

- Develop and enhance tools, policies, and controls to prevent, detect, and remediate antitrust risks.

Ethics & Compliance

- Support the broader Ethics & Compliance Program in EMEA and APAC in collaboration with the global team.

- Contribute to risk assessments, monitoring activities, and compliance governance.

- Support implementation of Environmental & Social Responsibility (E&SR) reporting compliance, including:
- EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD)

- Other ESG disclosure frameworks (e.g., ISSB-aligned regimes)

- Act as a bridge between compliance and business teams, ensuring effective communication and escalation of risks.

- Help adapt and operationalize global compliance initiatives at regional level.

Skills for Success

The ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and skills:

- Law degree (European or U.S.). Candidates qualified outside Europe must have a strong, proven track record of advising on European competition law, including practical exposure to EU distribution and antitrust frameworks.

- Strong and demonstrable expertise in antitrust / competition law (essential).

- Significant experience advising on distribution, wholesale, and commercial practices from a competition law perspective.

- Proven ability to translate complex legal concepts into pragmatic, business-oriented guidance.

- Experience designing or managing antitrust compliance programs (training, policies, monitoring, investigations, dawn raids action plans).

- Understanding of the wholesale ecosystem , including physical and digital distribution channels.

- Exposure to broader Ethics & Compliance or regulatory compliance areas (e.g., ESG, anti-corruption, sanctions) is a plus.

- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills in a global, matrixed organization.

- Excellent communication skills in English.

- Availability to travel (up to 25%).

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

- A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

- Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

jobs.description:
VerkäuferIn (Teilzeit 8 Std.)

The North Face – Landquart, Schweiz

Unbefristete Anstellung

8 Stunden pro Woche

Flexible Wochenendverfügbarkeit erforderlich

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und ergreifen Sie die Chance, Teil eines großartigen Teams zu werden und die Verantwortung dafür zu übernehmen, unseren KundInnen ein unvergessliches Einkaufserlebnis zu bieten!

Für unser The North Face‑Team in Landquart suchen wir eine/n begeisterte/n VerkäuferIn in Teilzeit (8 Std.).

Als VerkäuferIn inspirieren Sie unsere KundInnen, bieten einen herausragenden Kundenservice und sorgen dafür, dass unser Verkaufsraum die höchsten Standards erfüllt.

The North Face gehört zur VF‑Familie. Mit unserer Familie von renommierten Marken mit Kultfaktor verbindet das internationale Bekleidungsunternehmen VF Menschen mit den Lifestyles, Aktivitäten und Erlebnissen, die sie lieben. Im Zentrum unserer Arbeit liegt unser Ziel:
We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. Das ist unser Ziel. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Es vereint uns und motiviert uns, unsere Pläne gemeinsam zu verfolgen. Das ist unsere Berufung.

The North Face ist die weltweit führende Outdoor‑ und Abenteuer‑Marke. Wir verbreiten Neugier. Wir wagen Außergewöhnliches. Wir bilden Gemeinschaften. Und wir führen mit Integrität. Wir sind eine Gemeinschaft von Entdeckern und ständig auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen, Orten und Menschen, mit denen wir eine Verbindung aufbauen können.

Über die Position

Unsere VerkäuferInnen haben bei uns die großartige Gelegenheit, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Denn bei uns unterstützen Sie ein internationales Unternehmen und werden darin bekräftigt, auf Filialebene Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Sie machen den Unterschied

Von unseren VerkäuferInnen erwarten wir, dass sie ein unvergessliches Einkaufserlebnis bieten, indem sie:

-
Erstklassigen Kundenservice liefern und dadurch den respektvollen Umgang mit allen KundInnen sicherstellen

-
Genauestens über die in der Filiale angebotenen Produkte Bescheid wissen

-
Merchandising‑Standards gemäß den Markenrichtlinien aufrechterhalten

-
Stets im Bilde über die neuesten Trends und die aktuelle Positionierung der Marke innerhalb des Marktes sind

-
Alle betrieblichen Abläufe in der Filiale und im Lagerraum einhalten

Was macht Sie zum/zur perfekten VerkäuferIn?

-
Sie lieben den direkten Kundenkontakt. Mit Ihrer praxisorientierten Mentalität, Ihrem Enthusiasmus und Ihrer Leidenschaft für das Schaffen eines fantastischen Kundenerlebnisses gehen Sie mit gutem Beispiel für den Rest des Teams voran.

-
Sie haben eine positive, proaktive Einstellung und nehmen sich jeder Situation in der Filiale an

-
Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für unsere Marke, Mode und Einzelhandel im Allgemeinen

-
Sie besitzen hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

-
Sie sind flexibel und würden bei Bedarf auch an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und in den Abendstunden arbeiten

-
Erfahrung ist großartig, aber nicht erforderlich. Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Sie unsere Leitsätze leben und demonstrieren: Leben Sie pflichtbewusst, handeln Sie mutig und empathisch, seien Sie neugierig und bleiben Sie standhaft.

Das erwartet Sie

Bei uns erhalten Sie das volle Leistungspaket.

Die meisten Unternehmen werben mit konkurrenzfähigem Gehalt, einem fantastischem Bonus, Altersvorsorge und Mitarbeiterrabatten (übrigens: bei uns gibt es 50 %!). All das bieten wir auch. Nur anders. Neben all dem bieten wir Ihnen:

-
Karriereverantwortung, die es Ihnen ermöglicht, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung über verschiedene Marken hinweg aufzubauen

-
Eine unterstützende, auf Feedback basierende Arbeitskultur, in der Respekt und Integrität unsere Wegweiser sind

-

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel L&E Corporate (EMEA)
jobs.location: EMEA · CHE · Stabio · VF Campus VF1
jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Senior Legal Counsel L&E Corporate (EMEA) to join our Legal team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role!

Reporting directly to the Vice President Regional General Counsel, the Senior Legal Counsel L&E Corporate (EMEA) provides pragmatic, business-oriented legal support across VF’s corporate activities in the region.

The Corporate Business Area remit is broad and includes, among other matters, corporate & finance support (governance, entity management and restructuring, intragroup and financing arrangements), acquisitions and divestitures (including M&A and integration), property & real estate, and sourcing & supply chain matters, as well as relevant compliance workstreams (e.g., SOX-, tax- and ESG-related support, as applicable). Within this wider scope, l abor & employment (L&E) is a primary accountability of the role: you are expected to identify, lead and coordinate L&E advice as a cross-cutting workstream, translate employment risk into clear business actions in close partnership with HR and other stakeholders, and support consistent employment risk management and reporting across the region.

To that end, the Business Area Leader will ensure the use of the Department’s TAC operating model across their team to drive rigorous, value-driven delivery of legal services to VF clients. The TAC model emphasizes a cross-brand service approach and close collaboration across VF brands and shared functions. This description is intended to attract Employment Counsel or Corporate Counsel profiles with a strong labor & employment foundation, able to operate in a broad corporate scope while owning L&E accountability as a critical, cross-cutting workstream.

Primary Accountabilities:

Within the framework of VF's strategic reorganization and the pivotal role of the Business Area Corporate, the Business Area Leader shall shoulder the following primary responsibilities:

• Resource Allocation: Devise exhaustive plans detailing resource deployment. This entails scoping the need for both internal expertise and external legal partnerships, while assessing potential ROI.

• Legal Surveillance: Continually monitor legal nuances, especially those impacting corporate governance, acquisitions, divestitures, and the other intricate facets of the Corporate Business Area within the region.

• Strategic Counsel: Offer informed legal direction on the Legal Matters specified in the Annex. Collaborate with other Business Area leads to spot common intersections in strategy and potential legal risks. Offer strategic legal advice, particularly on matters of corporate structuring, labour and employment, and overarching corporate strategy.

jobs.title: VerkäuferIn – Flexibel Teilzeit oder Vollzeit Napapijri Landquart Fashion Outlet
jobs.description:
VerkäuferIn – Flexibel Teilzeit oder Vollzeit

Napapijri Landquart Fashion Outlet

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und ergreifen Sie die Chance, Teil eines großartigen Teams zu werden und die Verantwortung dafür zu übernehmen, unseren KundInnen ein unvergessliches Einkaufserlebnis zu bieten!

Für unser Napapijri-Team in Napapijri Landquart Fashion Outlet suchen wir eine/n begeisterte/n VerkäuferIn.

Als VerkäuferIn inspirieren Sie unsere KundInnen, bieten einen herausragenden Kundenservice und sorgen dafür, dass unser Verkaufsraum die höchsten Standards erfüllt.

Napapijri gehört zur VF-Familie. Mit unserer Familie von renommierten Marken mit Kultfaktor verbindet das internationale Bekleidungsunternehmen VF Menschen mit den Lifestyles, Aktivitäten und Erlebnissen, die sie lieben. Im Zentrum unserer Arbeit liegt unser Ziel: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. Das ist unser Ziel. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Es vereint uns und motiviert uns, unsere Pläne gemeinsam zu verfolgen. Das ist unsere Berufung.

Napapijri ist eine Marke für hochwertige Freizeitbekleidung. In unserer Arbeit verschmelzen Design, Nachhaltigkeit und Innovation. Durch Inklusivität und deren unermüdliche Umsetzung liegt unser Augenmerk auf einer positiven Zukunft.

Über die Position

Unsere VerkäuferInnen haben bei uns die großartige Gelegenheit, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Denn bei uns unterstützen Sie ein internationales Unternehmen und werden darin bekräftigt, auf Filialebene Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Sie machen den Unterschied

Von unseren VerkäuferInnen erwarten wir, dass sie ein unvergessliches Einkaufserlebnis bieten, indem sie:

-
Erstklassigen Kundenservice liefern und dadurch den respektvollen Umgang mit allen KundInnen sicherstellen

-
Genauestens über die in der Filiale angebotenen Produkte Bescheid wissen

-
Merchandising-Standards gemäß den Markenrichtlinien aufrechterhalten

-
Stets im Bilde über die neuesten Trends und die aktuelle Positionierung der Marke innerhalb des Marktes sind

-
Alle betrieblichen Abläufe in der Filiale und im Lagerraum einhalten.

Was macht Sie zum/zur perfekten VerkäuferIn?

-
Sie lieben den direkten Kundenkontakt. Mit Ihrer praxisorientierten Mentalität, Ihrem Enthusiasmus und Ihrer Leidenschaft für das Schaffen eines fantastischen Kundenerlebnisses gehen Sie mit gutem Beispiel für den Rest des Teams voran.

-
Sie haben eine positive, proaktive Einstellung und nehmen sich jeder Situation in der Filiale an

-
Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für unsere Marke, Mode und Einzelhandel im Allgemeinen

-
Sie besitzen hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

-
Sie sind flexibel und würden bei Bedarf auch an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und in den Abendstunden arbeiten

Erfahrung ist großartig, aber nicht erforderlich. Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Sie unsere Leitsätze leben und demonstrieren: Leben Sie pflichtbewusst, handeln Sie mutig und empathisch, seien Sie neugierig und bleiben Sie standhaft.

Das erwartet Sie

Wir bieten umfassende Leistungen, die das geistige, körperliche und finanzielle Wohlbefinden aller VF-MitarbeiterInnen fördern. Bei uns erhalten Sie das volle Leistungspaket.

Die meisten Unternehmen werben mit konkurrenzfähigem Gehalt, einem fantastischem Bonus, Altersvorsorge und Mitarbeiterrabatten (übrigens: bei uns gibt es 50 %!). All das bieten wir auch. Nur anders. Neben all dem bieten wir Ihnen:

-
Karriereverantwortung, die es Ihnen ermöglicht, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung über verschiedene Marken hinweg aufzubauen

-
Eine unterstützende, auf Feedback basierende Arbeitskultur, in der Respekt und Integrität unsere Wegweiser sind

-
Maßgeschneidertes Training. Von der Einarbeitung bis hin zu laufenden Trainings online und in Präsenz sind wir bestrebt, Sie bei Ihrer beruflichen sowie persönlichen Entwicklung so gut es geht zu unterstützen

-
Die Möglichkeit, sich mit anderen FilialleiterInnen in ganz Europa und unserem Unternehmenssitz zu vernetzen

-
Wir unterstützen ggf. Sie bei Ihrem Umzug

-
Teilnahme am Referral-Programm

-
Zur Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeiter bieten wir ein Programm für mentale Gesundheit an

Freie Entfaltung

Unser Bestreben ist es, eine Kultur der Zugehörigkeit zu fördern, die auf Respekt, Verbundenheit, Offenheit und Authentizität basiert. Wir haben uns dem Aufbau und Erhalt eines Arbeitsplatzes verschrieben, der die Vielfalt unserer MitarbeiterInnen zelebriert, damit sie während ihrer Arbeit ganz sie selbst sein können.

VF ist ein Arbeitgeber, der sich für Chancengleichheit, die Förderung und die Unterstützung benachteiligter Gruppen engagiert, indem er gleiche Chancen sowohl für VF-MitarbeiterInnen als auch für BewerberInnen schafft.

Wenn Ihnen all das, was Sie soeben gelesen haben, zusagt und Sie Teil unseres Teams werden möchten, würden wir uns sehr freuen, von Ihnen zu hören!

#readytoapply

jobs.title: PSS Analyst - THE NORTH FACE
jobs.location: EMEA · CHE · Stabio · VF Campus VF1
jobs.description:
The North Face EMEA is looking for an outstanding PSS Analyst to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Focus of this role will be on Retail Partner and Concession channel, with the key objective to create and implement new ways of working to elevate our Merchandise Planning and Trading aligned with the DTC business.

You will be responsible for merchandise trading including all inventory management and Retail KPIs management and cross-functional go-to-market alignment and performance tracking. Also, you will play a key role to further strengthen our Retail Partner business in ITALY and GAS region, working closely with our Retail and Concession manager throughout the selling campaign.

How you will make a difference

-
Lead and evolve best-in-class digital Merchandising Planning process fully aligned with our DTC strategy, positioning and with the seasonal merchandising strategy;

-
Full ownership to manage the performance of the defined assortment, working closely with a cross-functional team dedicated to B&M (Buyers and Retail Partner managers) ;

-
Work alongside our TNG buying team and PSS managers to manage seasonal, monthly and weekly intake requirements;

-
Working on Inventory Management and coverage optimization at product/size level and across our DCs, with focus on trading performance and stock level optimization, delivering against The North Face B&M and financial objectives;

-
Full alignment with overall go-to-market calendar to ensure seamless execution and strong accelerated growth;

-
Working in partnership with Buying, PSS and Sales Ops team on the development of yearly and seasonal merchandise financial plans across Revenue, COGS, Discounts, Margins, ASP and Units

-
Set standards of trading and buying processes and deliver best practices to be shared across our cross-functional teams, proactively proposing continuous improvements in processes and tools in collaboration with DTC counterparts and VF Central Team to reach trading excellence and best-in-class inventory management execution;

-
Constantly striving for innovation and to optimise ways of working by contributing in setting up new processes, tools and report.

What you need to succeed?

-
3+ yrs. of relevant work experience with proven track record in Merchandising Planning, trading or equivalent Business Planning/Trading role

-
Language skills: fluent in English and Italian

-
Relevant Merchandise Planning and analysis experience within a fast-paced retail business

-
Deep understanding of the fast-paced B&M environment and merchandising success factors for Retails

-
Outstanding understanding of all the Retail KPIs and how they are influencing stores’ P&L

-
Excellent knowledge of Excel. Knowledge of Access, SAP and BI systems is a plus.

-
Excellent analytical skills

-
Outstanding business- and financial acumen

-
Consumer-first, data savvy and brand-driven mindset

-
Highly performance driven and result-oriented team player who is getting things done

-
High maturity in managing organisational complexity and effective communication

-
Strategic and operational decision-making

A formal education and subsequent University Bachelor or Master’s degree in related fields are nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.

What is in it for you?

-
Playing a key role to accelerate our B&M growth within one of our leading brands

-
Joining an ambitious Retail and Concession team embedded into The North Face and VF, one of the largest, globally leading multi-brand organisations with great long-term career opportunities

-
Purpose-led, international, fun and challenging working environment

We're in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That's why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we're the total package.

-
A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

-
An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

-
Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

-
On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

-
50% discount on all VF brands

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Join the North Face Family

The North Face was built on a love for the outdoors and the desire to enable all types of exploration, for all people, from their backyards to the Himalayas. Over the last 50 years we've lived by our "true north," the belief that exploration has the power to change us, to challenge us and to help us see the world from new perspectives. To help ignite a global movement of outdoor exploration, love for the natural world and an unwavering commitment to protect it, we welcome and encourage new participants to the outdoors. We extend our reach through support of non-profit organizations, establishing programs that connect participants with close-to-home recreation opportunities, and creating a connection with young leaders, inspiring them to explore and conserve. As we enter our sixth decade, we pledge to:

-
Empower exploration and the thrill of the unknown for as many people as possible

-
Protect the places where we live, play, and operate

-
Evolve the way we make our products by improving our environmental performance and social responsibility in the supply chain

Our Parent Company, VF Corporation

VF is one of the world's largest apparel, footwear and accessories companies connecting people to the lifestyles, activities and experiences they cherish through our family of iconic outdoor, active and workwear brands. At the heart of our journey lies our company-wide purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It's the reason we come to work every day. It's a commitment shared by our global associates across all brands. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

Please submit your application in English, as that's our common language!

jobs.description:
About Altra

Altra isn’t just a shoe. It’s a promise. It all started when we hacked the typical running shoe, challenging industry convention by opening the toe box so your feet could splay naturally. Born from a passion for innovation and natural running, Altra designs footwear that helps runners move more naturally with the Altra Fit, allowing toes to spread for enhanced comfort, balance and strength. To help you Stay Out There™ for more miles and more years.

Be a part of our journey!

The Role

We're looking for a versatile and highly creative Content Specialist to join the Altra EMEA Marketing team.

This role serves as the team's in-house creative resource, combining graphic design, content creation and AI-powered creative development to support marketing initiatives across the region.

Working as a hands-on creator, you will personally design, capture, edit and deliver content that brings the Altra brand to life across Europe. From adapting global campaign assets for regional needs to creating original content at events, athlete activations and product launches, you will play a critical role in helping the brand connect with consumers, customers and partners.

Unlike traditional marketing content roles, this position is focused on hands-on content creation rather than agency management. The successful candidate will personally create, capture, edit and deliver content across multiple formats and channels while helping the team embrace new AI-powered creative workflows.

This role is ideal for a modern creative professional who is equally comfortable designing in Adobe Creative Suite, filming and editing video content, capturing photography and leveraging emerging AI technologies to improve creative output, efficiency and effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Content Adaptation

- Localising global campaign assets for regional market requirements.

- Adapting creative assets across multiple marketing channels and customer touchpoints.

- Designing retail, digital and marketing collateral to support regional activation plans.

- Editing and repurposing existing content for different formats, audiences and channels.

- Creating creative asset variations for different marketing needs.

- Ensuring all adapted content remains aligned with brand guidelines and creative standards.

- Managing and organising regional creative assets and content libraries.

Content Creation

Develop original content that supports the needs of the EMEA marketing organisation.

Responsibilities include:

- Personally capturing photography and videography content across a wide range of marketing initiatives.

- Producing original content to support product launches, campaigns, events and brand storytelling.

- Creating product-focused photography and video assets.

- Filming and editing content for digital and social channels.

- Producing educational and training content.

- Creating internal communications and presentation materials.

- Owning the complete production process from concept through capture, editing and final delivery.

- Building and maintaining a library of original EMEA content assets.

- Identifying opportunities to maximise the value of content by repurposing assets across multiple channels and markets.

AI-Powered Creative Development

Leverage emerging AI technologies to enhance creative output and improve production efficiency.

- Using AI-powered tools to accelerate image, design and video workflows.

- Developing creative asset variations to support different marketing requirements.

- Exploring and implement AI-generated creative solutions where appropriate.

- Identifying opportunities to improve content production through AI-enabled workflows.

- Staying current with emerging creative technologies and best practices.

- Acting as a champion for AI-assisted creativity within the marketing team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with marketing stakeholders across the business to support content and creative requirements spanning:

- Retail

- eCommerce

- Social Media

- Brand Marketing

- Distributor Markets

- Media

This role requires the ability to balance multiple stakeholder requests while ensuring all creative output remains aligned with brand standards and business priorities.

Skills For Success

Essential

- Experience in graphic design, content creation or creative production.

- Strong Adobe Creative Suite skills, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.

- Advanced video editing capabilities using Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent software.

- Strong photography and videography skills.

- Ability to independently shoot, edit and deliver final creative assets.

- Understanding of content creation best practices across digital channels.

- Experience using AI creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Gemini, Runway or similar platforms.

- Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced marketing environment.

- Ability to travel within the EMEA region when required for shoots, events and community activations.

Desirable

- Experience within the running, sports, outdoor or lifestyle industries.

- Motion graphics and animation experience.

- Experience creating retail and wholesale marketing content.

- Passion for running and endurance sports.

Who You Are

- A creative problem solver who enjoys turning ideas into compelling content.

- Equally comfortable designing graphics, filming content and editing video.

- Curious about emerging technologies and how they can improve the creative process.

- A hands-on creator who enjoys making rather than managing.

- Highly organised and able to balance multiple projects and deadlines.

- Collaborative and comfortable working across different marketing functions.

- Adaptable and eager to learn new skills and technologies.

- Passionate about storytelling and bringing brands to life through great creative execution.

What’s In It For You?

Most companies like to say they offer a competitive salary, an amazing bonus/benefit and pension scheme as well as staff discounts. We also do this, only quite different.

Because it’s not just our products which set us apart from others. It’s our people, and we believe they deserve to be nurtured and looked after. That’s why, on top of the usual benefits, we offer much more:

- Career ownership, enabling you to build your knowledge and experience across different brands and even different countries.

- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do.

- Tailored training. From a thorough induction to ongoing online and face-to-face training, we are committed to helping you grow, both professionally and personally.

- An inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together.

- On-site gym offering health and well-being initiatives.

- Subsidised canteen as well as break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks.

Free To Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, VF is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both VF associates and applicants alike.

If you like what you have read and want to join the journey of our team, then we would like to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Timberland EMEA is looking for an exceptional Merchandiser – Women’s Apparel & Accessories (Timberland EMEA) to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Founded in 1973, Timberland® is a global outdoor lifestyle brand. Best known for its original yellow boot designed for the harsh elements of New England, Timberland today offers a full range of footwear, apparel and accessories for people who value purposeful style and share the brand’s passion for enjoying – and protecting – nature.

At the heart of the Timberland brand is the core belief that a greener future is a better future. This comes to life through a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and strengthen communities around the world.

Let’s Talk about the Role

The Merchandiser for Women’s Apparel & Accessories at Timberland EMEA is responsible for building consumer-right assortments, driving DTC excellence, and supporting Timberland’s brand elevation across the region. The role blends product insight, commercial analysis, and a strong understanding of the Timberland consumer to deliver profitable, on-brand collections for the EMEA marketplace. This role reports into the Apparel Merchandising Manager.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

-
Women’s and Accessories Assortment Strategy: build seasonal assortments for women’s apparel and accessories aligned with Timberland’s EMEA brand direction, ensuring relevance across lifestyle, outdoor, and streetwear expressions and creating clear, consumer-relevant seasonal stories.

-
SMU Development & Account Differentiation: identify opportunities for SMUs (Special Make-Ups), capsules and collaborations to support strategic wholesale key accounts, drive differentiation across channels, strengthen partnerships, and increase desirability and cultural relevance.

-
Pre-Season Management: lead the pre-season process by defining category strategies, target assortments, pricing architecture, and channel segmentation. Build line plans based on consumer insights, historical performance, and marketplace needs. Partner with Planning and Global Merchandising to set financial targets, SKU productivity expectations, margin objectives, and full-price performance ambitions.

-
Go-To-Market & Pre-Line Presentation: deliver compelling GTM and pre-line presentations that clearly communicate product stories, category strategies, and commercial opportunities. Influence internal teams and key accounts through strong storytelling, visual clarity, and confident delivery.

-
DTC Excellence: define premium DTC assortments, segmentation, and product storytelling in partnership with Retail and VM teams to elevate full-price performance and improve sell-through in women’s categories.

-
Brand Elevation & Streetwear Relevance: curate consumer-centric assortments, capsules, collaborations, and SMUs that enhance desirability, cultural relevance, and Timberland’s brand elevation in the EMEA marketplace.

-
Unlock Wholesale Marketplace Growth: accelerate the women’s business by unlocking opportunities with strategic wholesale key accounts. Tailor assortments, pricing, and product stories to drive category growth and strengthen Timberland’s position in the marketplace.

-
GTM & Line Architecture: translate global direction into EMEA-specific line architecture, pricing, and GTM tools that support sell-in and sell-out success and effective differentiation across DTC and wholesale channels.

-
In-Season Management: steer in-season performance by tracking productivity KPIs (sell-through, ROS, UPT, conversion) and marginality KPIs (IMU, maintained margin, markdown impact). Identify risks and opportunities, propose corrective actions, and partner with Planning and Sales to maximize profitability across DTC and wholesale.

-
Cross-Functional Leadership: partner with Planning, Sales, Marketing, VM, and Global Merchandising to align on consumer insights, marketplace needs, and brand priorities.

Skills for Success

-
Fashion Merchandising Expertise: strong understanding of women’s apparel and accessories, including fits, fabrics, category dynamics, and seasonal assortment planning within lifestyle, outdoor, or streetwear environments.

-
Analytical & Commercial Acumen: ability to analyze sell-in/sell-out data, margins, marketplace performance, full-price performance, sell-through, and category growth opportunities.

-
Brand & Consumer Insight: deep understanding of the Timberland consumer, the EMEA marketplace, and how to create clear, consumer-relevant seasonal stories aligned with Timberland’s brand elevation.

-
DTC & Omnichannel Mindset: background in DTC-led merchandising and omnichannel assortment planning, with the ability to differentiate assortments across DTC and wholesale channels.

-
Wholesale & Account Management: experience working with strategic wholesale key accounts and driving category growth through tailored assortments, product stories, capsules, collaborations, and SMUs.

-
Presentation & Storytelling Skills: ability to deliver clear, persuasive GTM and pre-line presentations that inspire internal teams and key accounts.

-
Cross-Functional Communication: strong collaboration skills across design, planning, sales, marketing, retail, VM, and global merchandising teams.

-
Tools & Systems: proficiency in PLM, Excel, and merchandising systems.

-
Experience Requirement: 2–5 years of experience in merchandising, buying, or planning, ideally within women’s apparel or accessories and within a global lifestyle, outdoor, or streetwear brand.

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling.

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

-
A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

-
An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

-
Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi-brand, multi-country organization

-
On-site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

-
A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

-
Break-out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team, then we would like to hear from you!

Timberland EMEA is looking for an exceptional Merchandiser – Women’s Apparel & Accessories (Timberland EMEA) to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Founded in 1973, Timberland® is a global outdoor lifestyle brand. Best known for its original yellow boot designed for the harsh elements of New England, Timberland today offers a full range of footwear, apparel and accessories for people who value purposeful style and share the brand’s passion for enjoying – and protecting – nature.

At the heart of the Timberland brand is the core belief that a greener future is a better future. This comes to life through a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and strengthen communities around the world.

Let’s Talk about the Role

The Merchandiser for Women’s Apparel & Accessories at Timberland EMEA is responsible for building consumer-right assortments, driving DTC excellence, and supporting Timberland’s brand elevation across the region. The role blends product insight, commercial analysis, and a strong understanding of the Timberland consumer to deliver profitable, on-brand collections for the EMEA marketplace. This role reports into the Apparel Merchandising Manager.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

-
Women’s and Accessories Assortment Strategy: build seasonal assortments for women’s apparel and accessories aligned with Timberland’s EMEA brand direction, ensuring relevance across lifestyle, outdoor, and streetwear expressions and creating clear, consumer-relevant seasonal stories.

-
SMU Development & Account Differentiation: identify opportunities for SMUs (Special Make-Ups), capsules and collaborations to support strategic wholesale key accounts, drive differentiation across channels, strengthen partnerships, and increase desirability and cultural relevance.

-
Pre-Season Management: lead the pre-season process by defining category strategies, target assortments, pricing architecture, and channel segmentation. Build line plans based on consumer insights, historical performance, and marketplace needs. Partner with Planning and Global Merchandising to set financial targets, SKU productivity expectations, margin objectives, and full-price performance ambitions.

-
Go-To-Market & Pre-Line Presentation: deliver compelling GTM and pre-line presentations that clearly communicate product stories, category strategies, and commercial opportunities. Influence internal teams and key accounts through strong storytelling, visual clarity, and confident delivery.

-
DTC Excellence: define premium DTC assortments, segmentation, and product storytelling in partnership with Retail and VM teams to elevate full-price performance and improve sell-through in women’s categories.

-
Brand Elevation & Streetwear Relevance: curate consumer-centric assortments, capsules, collaborations, and SMUs that enhance desirability, cultural relevance, and Timberland’s brand elevation in the EMEA marketplace.

-
Unlock Wholesale Marketplace Growth: accelerate the women’s business by unlocking opportunities with strategic wholesale key accounts. Tailor assortments, pricing, and product stories to drive category growth and strengthen Timberland’s position in the marketplace.

-
GTM & Line Architecture: translate global direction into EMEA-specific line architecture, pricing, and GTM tools that support sell-in and sell-out success and effective differentiation across DTC and wholesale channels.

-
In-Season Management: steer in-season performance by tracking productivity KPIs (sell-through, ROS, UPT, conversion) and marginality KPIs (IMU, maintained margin, markdown impact). Identify risks and opportunities, propose corrective actions, and partner with Planning and Sales to maximize profitability across DTC and wholesale.

-
Cross-Functional Leadership: partner with Planning, Sales, Marketing, VM, and Global Merchandising to align on consumer insights, marketplace needs, and brand priorities.

Skills for Success

-
Fashion Merchandising Expertise: strong understanding of women’s apparel and accessories, including fits, fabrics, category dynamics, and seasonal assortment planning within lifestyle, outdoor, or streetwear environments.

-
Analytical & Commercial Acumen: ability to analyze sell-in/sell-out data, margins, marketplace performance, full-price performance, sell-through, and category growth opportunities.

-
Brand & Consumer Insight: deep understanding of the Timberland consumer, the EMEA marketplace, and how to create clear, consumer-relevant seasonal stories aligned with Timberland’s brand elevation.

-
DTC & Omnichannel Mindset: background in DTC-led merchandising and omnichannel assortment planning, with the ability to differentiate assortments across DTC and wholesale channels.

-
Wholesale & Account Management: experience working with strategic wholesale key accounts and driving category growth through tailored assortments, product stories, capsules, collaborations, and SMUs.

-
Presentation & Storytelling Skills: ability to deliver clear, persuasive GTM and pre-line presentations that inspire internal teams and key accounts.

-
Cross-Functional Communication: strong collaboration skills across design, planning, sales, marketing, retail, VM, and global merchandising teams.

-
Tools & Systems: proficiency in PLM, Excel, and merchandising systems.

-
Experience Requirement: 2–5 years of experience in merchandising, buying, or planning, ideally within women’s apparel or accessories and within a global lifestyle, outdoor, or streetwear brand.

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. jobs.description:
The North Face EMEA are looking for an outstanding Marketing Associate, Retail Production (Maternity Cover 1 year) to join our Marketing team of The North Face in our European Headquarter in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let's talk about the role

The Marketing Associate, Retail Production is responsible for supporting all functions and aspects of the The North Face Go To Market process from season’s launch until the in store execution building on the consumer experience driven by Purpose and Creative Vision, across The North Face 4 walls environments.

The selected candidate will also take care of external communications as main point of contact for Retail Marketing campaign executions and bespoke retail projects(seasonal windows, store customizations, POP material, instore videos, store takeover), as well as coordinating external agencies and vendors in order to deliver all the seasonal campaigns on time and on budget with strong focus of retail marketing briefing to brand team, collecting input from operations, product merchandising and visual merchandising team, in collaboration with the Creative Environment Coordinator. Internal communications with Brand Team/ Creative Team/ Retail Team/ Global Team from brief creation to project share out and final report is also a key task to deal with.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

For full price, outlets, and partner stores briefing, project management and support to rollout:

Retail Marketing Tasks:

-
Windows & POP

-
Store Environment including both images and digital contents

-
Sale, Seasonal Graphics, and commercial POS

-
Special projects

-
Retail activation communication

-
Overseeing the production phase to ensure that all the assets are delivered on time and on budget

-
Briefing the seasonal assets creation for EMEA Region working close with Global team, VM, Brand, Creative and Retail Operation Managers to develop the Seasonal Toolkit and to supporting VM guidelines.

-
Prototype phase: support of prototype phase taking into consideration sustainable choices as well as costs.

-
Production phase: responsible of order forms preparation and artworks production for roll out

-
Monitoring the whole production process with particular focus on timings, costs, and sustainability to ensure all vendors in areas relating to Windows, POP, POS are committed to roll out programs on time and on budget with particular attention to sustainable choices.

-
Newsletter: responsible to provide monthly report about window & POP overview, including relevant data.

Administrative task

-
Monitor and ensure Managed Creative Environment budget and invoicing is driven effectively and appropriately.

-
Maintain up to date budget sheets for all development projects and provide monthly updates and reports on all such projects, timed actions, and visits.

-
Responsible for regular project updates and reports.

Skills for Success

-
Degree in Design, Architecture or Marketing.

-
​ A minimum of 3/5 years’ experience of Project Management, Production processes, Tender processes and purchasing, Creative Development, Trade Marketing, Visual Communication / Visual Merchandising, working with external vendors and agencies is required preferably within the branded apparel or footwear industries.

-
Solid experience on Project Management supporting production processes, tender processes and purchasing.

-
Demonstrate creative and technical design ability, competent in suitable visual packages and presentations

-
Sound knowledge of high-end retail brand environments.

-
Digital and brand marketing experience is a plus

-
Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate at all levels. A proven ability to work independently is required.

-
English is mandatory; an additional European language would be highly desirable.

-
Proficiency in Office Package (Power point and Excel), Key Notes, Adobe Creative Pack is required.

-
Strong capabilities in fast problem solving and organizational skills for managing many projects simultaneously.

What's in it for you?

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

-
Be part of iconic lifestyle brands

-
Join a multi brand and multi countries organization to drive you career forward

-
International and challenging working culture

-
On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

-
Discount 50% on all VF brands

-
Subsidized canteen as well as break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

About VF

VF Corporation is one of the world's largest apparel, footwear and accessories companies connecting people to the lifestyles, activities and experiences they cherish most through a family of iconic outdoor, active and workwear brands including Vans®, The North Face® and Timberland® . VF's purpose is to power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Senior Analyst Record to Report to join our team based in Stabio Switzerland .

Let’s talk about the role!

As an RTR Senior Analyst, your responsibility lies in ensuring the accuracy and timely execution of activities assigned within the RTR team. This involves verifying data accuracy and ensuring compliance with USGAAP accounting standards.

The role supports period-end close, General Ledger accuracy, balance sheet integrity and financial reporting in compliance with US GAAP and statutory accounting requirements, working closely with the RTR Manager, internal stakeholders and outsourced service providers.

In particular, the Record to Report Senior Analyst will support the Record to report team and the outsourcing provider with the following activities.

-
Perform month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities in line with the defined close calendar

-
Prepare and support review of journal entries. In case that entries are posted by the outsource provider, ensure that they are compliant with the operational instructions to be followed by them

-
Ensure accuracy and completeness in record to report transactions to maintain strong customer satisfaction and meet agreed service levels. To ensure data accuracy, you will be involved in the review of the monthly reconciliations which are prepared by the outsource provider

-
Support the reporting team in reviewing the variances period over period before the submission of the monthly reporting package with reference to the areas of your responsibility

-
Identify risks associated with the execution of assigned tasks within the business process and escalate/mitigate/resolve as required

-
Act as a key point of contact for internal and external audit teams, including SOX-related reviews and deep-dive requests, providing supporting documentation and responding to queries raised

-
Work closely with the Statutory team to ensure alignment between US GAAP and local statutory accounting

Skills for Success:

The ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and skills:

-
Educational Background: master’s degree in accounting

-
Professional Experience: At least 2-4 years of experience in Record To Report Processes (GL accounting) or experience in public accounting. Experience in an international setting is preferred. Skilled in:

-
Financial Statement

-
Accounting Fundamentals (US GAAP especially and local GAAP)

-
Language Proficiency: Fluency in English is essential (written and spoken)

-
Teamwork and Diversity: Enthusiastic about working and socializing in a diverse, inclusive, and multicultural environment.

-
Personal Attributes: Proactive, meticulous, and reliable with a positive mindset and a keen desire to learn and grow professionally.

jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Analyst, Central Costing to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role

The Central Costing Analyst plays a key role in supporting brand margin visibility through accurate, timely, and insightful costing analysis. The role is responsible for maintaining the costing database, collecting and validating costing inputs, and ensuring that Standard costs are correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP for the assigned brand(s).

Beyond data maintenance, the analyst supports seasonal cost and margin analysis across different levels of detail — from SKU level to product families and total collection level — helping Brand Management understand key cost drivers, margin evolution, and deviations from brand targets and long-range planning objectives.

The role contributes to identifying margin opportunities by analyzing the impact of product purchase cost changes, duty rates, allocation changes, sourcing assumptions, product mix, and other relevant cost drivers. This includes working closely with Sourcing, Brand Pricing, Planning, Customs, and Finance to ensure costing information is accurate, end-to-end consistent and business-relevant.

The analyst is also expected to support the application of AI-enabled costing models and tools to improve analysis, forecasting, reporting, and scenario evaluation.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

- Support seasonal cost and margin analysis by providing accurate and timely costing data, identifying and explaining key cost drivers — including purchase cost changes, duty impact, allocation changes, and other relevant variances — to support business decisions during seasonal reviews, planning cycles, and ad hoc evaluations.

- Build, maintain, and leverage costing tools, BI dashboards, and AI-supported analytical models by brand and season, consolidating relevant product information from line lists and other source files to support accurate and scalable costing analysis.

- Collect and validate product purchase cost inputs, Country of Origin, and dual sourcing options where applicable, from the different Sourcing Hubs.

- Collect trade agreement information and prepare the relevant database to support duty rate assessment in cooperation with the Customs team.

- Support the preparation and maintenance of data required for Standard Cost upload into SAP.

- Execute and monitor Standard Cost uploads in SAP for all relevant product categories, ensuring they remain updated across brands, warehouses, sites, and stores.

- Work closely with Merchandising to collect the forecast and buy plan assumptions they provide, ensuring product mix inputs are properly reflected in seasonal costing and margin analysis.

- Work proactively with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify missing information, improve data quality, and ensure costing assumptions are aligned across functions.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of costing processes, tools, databases, BI dashboards, and AI-supported analytical models, helping increase efficiency, transparency, and reliability across the end-to-end costing flow.

- AI-ENABLED FINANCE EXPECTATIONS : Routinely use AI-enabled tools to support analysis and reporting activities, in line with company guidelines and business needs; Apply sound professional judgment to review and challenge AI-generated outputs and leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to support speed, efficiency, and insight generation, while remaining accountable for analysis quality and providing reliable support to business decision-making.

Skills for Success

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required for the individual to be successful in this position.

- Education: University degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

- Experience: Financial background; prior experience in costing, controlling, supply chain finance, or a similar analytical role.

- Strong analytical mindset and AI fluency, with the ability to work effectively with large volumes of data and translate outputs into meaningful business insights.

- Ability to work across functions and manage relationships with multiple stakeholders.

- Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.

- Technical skills: Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; SAP knowledge is a plus.

VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Analyst, Central Costing to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role

The Central Costing Analyst plays a key role in supporting brand margin visibility through accurate, timely, and insightful costing analysis. The role is responsible for maintaining the costing database, collecting and validating costing inputs, and ensuring that Standard costs are correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP for the assigned brand(s).

Beyond data maintenance, the analyst supports seasonal cost and margin analysis across different levels of detail — from SKU level to product families and total collection level — helping Brand Management understand key cost drivers, margin evolution, and deviations from brand targets and long-range planning objectives.

The role contributes to identifying margin opportunities by analyzing the impact of product purchase cost changes, duty rates, allocation changes, sourcing assumptions, product mix, and other relevant cost drivers. This includes working closely with Sourcing, Brand Pricing, Planning, Customs, and Finance to ensure costing information is accurate, end-to-end consistent and business-relevant.

The analyst is also expected to support the application of AI-enabled costing models and tools to improve analysis, forecasting, reporting, and scenario evaluation.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

- Support seasonal cost and margin analysis by providing accurate and timely costing data, identifying and explaining key cost drivers — including purchase cost changes, duty impact, allocation changes, and other relevant variances — to support business decisions during seasonal reviews, planning cycles, and ad hoc evaluations.

- Build, maintain, and leverage costing tools, BI dashboards, and AI-supported analytical models by brand and season, consolidating relevant product information from line lists and other source files to support accurate and scalable costing analysis.

- Collect and validate product purchase cost inputs, Country of Origin, and dual sourcing options where applicable, from the different Sourcing Hubs.

- Collect trade agreement information and prepare the relevant database to support duty rate assessment in cooperation with the Customs team.

- Support the preparation and maintenance of data required for Standard Cost upload into SAP.

- Execute and monitor Standard Cost uploads in SAP for all relevant product categories, ensuring they remain updated across brands, warehouses, sites, and stores.

- Work closely with Merchandising to collect the forecast and buy plan assumptions they provide, ensuring product mix inputs are properly reflected in seasonal costing and margin analysis.

- Work proactively with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify missing information, improve data quality, and ensure costing assumptions are aligned across functions.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of costing processes, tools, databases, BI dashboards, and AI-supported analytical models, helping increase efficiency, transparency, and reliability across the end-to-end costing flow.

- AI-ENABLED FINANCE EXPECTATIONS : Routinely use AI-enabled tools to support analysis and reporting activities, in line with company guidelines and business needs; Apply sound professional judgment to review and challenge AI-generated outputs and leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to support speed, efficiency, and insight generation, while remaining accountable for analysis quality and providing reliable support to business decision-making.

Skills for Success

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required for the individual to be successful in this position.

- Education: University degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

- Experience: Financial background; prior experience in costing, controlling, supply chain finance, or a similar analytical role.

- Strong analytical mindset and AI fluency, with the ability to work effectively with large volumes of data and translate outputs into meaningful business insights.

- Ability to work across functions and manage relationships with multiple stakeholders.

- Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.

- Technical skills: Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; SAP knowledge is a plus.

- Strong analytical and organizational skills, with close attention to detail and high Standards of data accuracy.

- Proactive approach and ability to follow through on open topics with the relevant stakeholders.

- Clear communication skills, with the ability to summarize key findings and explain cost drivers effectively.

- Comfortable working in a dynamic and cross-functional environment.

jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for a Senior Manager, Product Sustainability & Circularity to join our Global Sustainability team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role!

As a Senior Manager, Product Sustainability & Circularity , you’ll be at the forefront of working across VF and its portfolio of brands to drive transformative change in alignment with our Global Sustainability strategy, current and emerging regulatory requirements, with a particular emphasis on circularity and product sustainability. The role will partner closely with Europe based brand teams and the global sustainability team to accurately measure and analyze brand data, and utilize brand priorities to drive impact reduction across carbon and waste.

The Senior Manager will drive progress that contributes to VF’s global sustainability goals and prepares VF brands for sustainability-related regulatory compliance. The role requires adept relationship building skills across both internal and external stakeholders.

We are a small team with big responsibilities. We innovate, design and implement sustainability initiatives across VF and its Brands through the lens of our Global Sustainability strategy and emerging regulatory requirements. The Senior Manager leads internal and external engagements and manages a team to collectively meet the future demands and needs of the region in alignment with global VF’s Global Sustainability programs.

How You Will Make a Difference

As Senior Manager, Product Sustainability & Circularity , you will be responsible for the following key activities and programs:

Product Sustainability & Circularity

- Leading a team focused on measuring, reducing, and reporting the impact of VF’s materials and products for Europe based brands or to report for EU specific regulations.

- Building capabilities & processes that improve data quality and analysis for upcoming product impact reporting and disclosures, by building expertise in AI data solutions for analysis and reporting

- Guide brand teams through EU regulation requirements & implement improvements for their product impact data.

- Support global brands with circular product design and innovation, including identification and vetting of circular materials and technologies, including textile to textile recycling, chemical recycling, and closed loop systems for both apparel and footwear materials

- Define and guide VF’s Circular Product Design strategy, aligned with emerging regulatory requirements, brand priorities, and the Global Sustainability Strategy.

- Collaborate with factory engagement teams to assess waste re-integration opportunities for our post-industrial scrap.

- Foster knowledge sharing and collaboration with VF teams in other regions to drive best practice adoption globally to prepare for emerging regulatory compliance.

- Partner with brand marketing, communication teams, and legal to manage and advise on internal and external communications and review externally facing product claims.

- Identify and manage external partners to support key VF circularity and product sustainability initiatives.

- Engage with Brand and VF function teams globally to raise knowledge of the sustainability related regulatory landscape and provide a clear strategic direction to ensure compliance, with a particular focus on ESPR, CSRSD, Repair and Green Claims.

- Represent the Global Sustainability team internally and externally, including key industry association meetings, circularity and sustainability conferences, VF Town Halls, and other events.

Environmental Regulatory Preparedness

- In partnership with VF’s Government Affairs, Global Sustainability, Product Stewardship, Legal teams, and external partners, follow key regulatory developments, provide expert input to emerging policy developments, and represent VF at key meetings and events focused on circularity-related regulatory requirements.

- Lead business process implementation to align with, and maximize opportunities from, upcoming product-related regulatory requirements in the EU.

Retailer Engagement

- Manage all retailer sustainability requests in EMEA, supporting all brands with the necessary knowledge and information. Engage with Brand Product and Sales teams, as well as the Global Traceability team to ensure effective data collection and reporting.

- Engage with key retailers in EMEA to ensure VF brands are strategically positioned from a sustainability perspective (e.g. Zalando)

Critical work relationships:

- Work horizontally across internal functions, including but not exclusive to Brand Teams, Global Sustainability, Legal, Finance, Government Affairs, local VF Sales Offices, Supply Chain, Product Stewardship, Digital Technology teams as well as external stakeholders to meet voluntary sustainability and circularity requirements, as well as mandatory regulatory requirements as they evolve.

- Work closely with Government Affairs and Legal Counsel to continuously integrate regulatory developments into the VF operational process.

Skills for Success

- Strong leadership skills with ability to manage a broad range of projects and stakeholders.

- You have a deep and proficient understanding of circular design and product sustainability.

- You have knowledge of synthetic materials and textile innovation.

- You have a network of solution providers/innovators in the circularity/sustainability field.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills and able to understand how to successfully lead cross-functional initiatives in highly matrixed organisations.

- 8+ years of experience in the field, preferably within the apparel or footwear industry or adjacent industries that share similar industrial production challenges.

- Strong grounding in environmental policy, and EU governance and public policy.

- Fluent in English (written and verbal); other languages are a plus.

- Strong understanding of the product creation cycle for apparel, footwear, and equipment.

- An understanding of corporate business processes and the industry operating model.

- Familiarity with key sustainability concepts and frameworks, e.g. circularity, decarbonisation levers, LCA, regenerative agriculture, nature impact.

- Ability to successfully support and prioritize multiple projects and teams at one time.

- Exposure to sustainability ratings and reporting frameworks including, but not limited to, GHG Protocol, Science Based Targets initiative, Net Zero, TCFD, CDP and CSRD.

- An ease to manoeuvre between different stakeholder groups and an ability to reconcile diverse inputs into an aligned pathway forward.

- Systems thinker with an ability to understand underlying connections and correlations.

- Strong communicator and enjoys working with people.

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

- A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

- Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.
