descriptionByLocale.it:
VF Corporation is looking for a Senior Manager, Product Sustainability & Circularity to join our Global Sustainability team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role!

As a Senior Manager, Product Sustainability & Circularity , you’ll be at the forefront of working across VF and its portfolio of brands to drive transformative change in alignment with our Global Sustainability strategy, current and emerging regulatory requirements, with a particular emphasis on circularity and product sustainability. The role will partner closely with Europe based brand teams and the global sustainability team to accurately measure and analyze brand data, and utilize brand priorities to drive impact reduction across carbon and waste.

The Senior Manager will drive progress that contributes to VF’s global sustainability goals and prepares VF brands for sustainability-related regulatory compliance. The role requires adept relationship building skills across both internal and external stakeholders.

We are a small team with big responsibilities. We innovate, design and implement sustainability initiatives across VF and its Brands through the lens of our Global Sustainability strategy and emerging regulatory requirements. The Senior Manager leads internal and external engagements and manages a team to collectively meet the future demands and needs of the region in alignment with global VF’s Global Sustainability programs.

How You Will Make a Difference

As Senior Manager, Product Sustainability & Circularity , you will be responsible for the following key activities and programs:

Product Sustainability & Circularity

- Leading a team focused on measuring, reducing, and reporting the impact of VF’s materials and products for Europe based brands or to report for EU specific regulations.

- Building capabilities & processes that improve data quality and analysis for upcoming product impact reporting and disclosures, by building expertise in AI data solutions for analysis and reporting

- Guide brand teams through EU regulation requirements & implement improvements for their product impact data.

- Support global brands with circular product design and innovation, including identification and vetting of circular materials and technologies, including textile to textile recycling, chemical recycling, and closed loop systems for both apparel and footwear materials

- Define and guide VF’s Circular Product Design strategy, aligned with emerging regulatory requirements, brand priorities, and the Global Sustainability Strategy.

- Collaborate with factory engagement teams to assess waste re-integration opportunities for our post-industrial scrap.

- Foster knowledge sharing and collaboration with VF teams in other regions to drive best practice adoption globally to prepare for emerging regulatory compliance.

- Partner with brand marketing, communication teams, and legal to manage and advise on internal and external communications and review externally facing product claims.

- Identify and manage external partners to support key VF circularity and product sustainability initiatives.

- Engage with Brand and VF function teams globally to raise knowledge of the sustainability related regulatory landscape and provide a clear strategic direction to ensure compliance, with a particular focus on ESPR, CSRSD, Repair and Green Claims.

- Represent the Global Sustainability team internally and externally, including key industry association meetings, circularity and sustainability conferences, VF Town Halls, and other events.

Environmental Regulatory Preparedness

- In partnership with VF’s Government Affairs, Global Sustainability, Product Stewardship, Legal teams, and external partners, follow key regulatory developments, provide expert input to emerging policy developments, and represent VF at key meetings and events focused on circularity-related regulatory requirements.

- Lead business process implementation to align with, and maximize opportunities from, upcoming product-related regulatory requirements in the EU.

Retailer Engagement

- Manage all retailer sustainability requests in EMEA, supporting all brands with the necessary knowledge and information. Engage with Brand Product and Sales teams, as well as the Global Traceability team to ensure effective data collection and reporting.

- Engage with key retailers in EMEA to ensure VF brands are strategically positioned from a sustainability perspective (e.g. Zalando)

Critical work relationships:

- Work horizontally across internal functions, including but not exclusive to Brand Teams, Global Sustainability, Legal, Finance, Government Affairs, local VF Sales Offices, Supply Chain, Product Stewardship, Digital Technology teams as well as external stakeholders to meet voluntary sustainability and circularity requirements, as well as mandatory regulatory requirements as they evolve.

- Work closely with Government Affairs and Legal Counsel to continuously integrate regulatory developments into the VF operational process.

Skills for Success

- Strong leadership skills with ability to manage a broad range of projects and stakeholders.

- You have a deep and proficient understanding of circular design and product sustainability.

- You have knowledge of synthetic materials and textile innovation.

- You have a network of solution providers/innovators in the circularity/sustainability field.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills and able to understand how to successfully lead cross-functional initiatives in highly matrixed organisations.

- 8+ years of experience in the field, preferably within the apparel or footwear industry or adjacent industries that share similar industrial production challenges.

- Strong grounding in environmental policy, and EU governance and public policy.

- Fluent in English (written and verbal); other languages are a plus.

- Strong understanding of the product creation cycle for apparel, footwear, and equipment.

- An understanding of corporate business processes and the industry operating model.

- Familiarity with key sustainability concepts and frameworks, e.g. circularity, decarbonisation levers, LCA, regenerative agriculture, nature impact.

- Ability to successfully support and prioritize multiple projects and teams at one time.

- Exposure to sustainability ratings and reporting frameworks including, but not limited to, GHG Protocol, Science Based Targets initiative, Net Zero, TCFD, CDP and CSRD.

- An ease to manoeuvre between different stakeholder groups and an ability to reconcile diverse inputs into an aligned pathway forward.

- Systems thinker with an ability to understand underlying connections and correlations.

- Strong communicator and enjoys working with people.

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

- A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

- Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

jobs.description:
VANS is looking for an exceptional Head of Retail to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s Talk about the Role

The Head of Retail is accountable for delivering retail revenue and profitability for the brand across EMEA, translating the brand strategy into commercially impactful consumer led retail execution.

The role sits within the retail organisation embedded in the brand and owns the end-to-end retail commercial plan, ensuring that every in-store experience is aligned to brand intent, drives conversion and delivers against financial targets.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

Retail Commercial Ownership

- Partner with key members of the Vans LT to define retail LRP goals aligned with GM and VP Retail.

- Deliver retail revenue, margin and contribution targets for the brand

- Translate brand and financial goals into a clear retail trading plan in partnership with functions (Planning, Merch & Brand), and ensure these are reflected in the financial plan and forecast.

- Lead the Retail SOE to make in season trading decisions to maximise performance for full price and outlet including agile inventory decisions.

Go to Market & Seasonal Execution

- Lead the retail go to market process, ensuring alignment with store concept and tiering.

- Own the retail commercial calendar anchored in key consumer moments e.g. seasonal peaks, campaigns, and local trading moments, defining seasonal priorities, product focus and storytelling in stores.

- Lead the definition of store tiering (based on consistent logic across brands) in partnership with planning and store operations aligned with brand intent.

Customer Experience

- Own the end-to-end store customer experience aligned with brand strategy.

- Elevate service models aligned to key commercial moments and product stories.

- Ensure strong brand expression through VM quality, store environment, and storytelling excellence.

- Maintain regular field presence, including joint store visits with District Managers, to observe execution, coach leadership behaviours, and stay connected to store reality.

Fleet Strategy

- Partner with the brand team to define and develop store concepts aligned to the role of O&O retail in the marketplace. Define the role of each store within the marketplace aligned to the tiering model.

- Partner with Finance, Real Estate, and field leaders to drive investment decisions and support lease negotiations.

- Oversee the full store lifecycle (openings, closures, relocations) aligned with the brand’s distribution strategy.

Skills for Success

You are a strategic retail leader with the ability to shape, scale, and elevate a modern brand experience across diverse markets. You bring:

- 10+ years of retail leadership experience ideally within global organizations. Background in global consumer, lifestyle, or fashion brands with complex and fast‑paced retail environments.

- Exceptional collaboration and influencing capabilities, with proven experience engaging and aligning senior stakeholders across Brand, Planning, Marketing, Merchandising, Finance, and Digital.

- Demonstrated ability to deliver commercial results with the ability to balance brand equity, consumer experience, and financial performance.

- Experience in retail network expansion, portfolio optimization, and the development of innovative store concepts.

- Fluency in English; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

-
A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

-
An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

-
Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

-
On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

-
A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

-
Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

jobs.description:
icebreaker is looking for an exceptional Technical Designer to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Driven by the belief that nature has the answers, we provide natural performance alternatives to synthetic-based apparel, to create a healthier and more sustainable future for our species and the planet. We're passionate about connecting people to natural alternatives.

Let’s Talk about the Role

As Technical Designer , you will be accountable for creating tools to support the execution of the icebreaker product line through the GTM process from concept to finished goods ensuring alignment with the brand strategy, global business needs, sourcing capabilities and quality standards.

This role plays a critical part in the precise execution of industry leading product to design intent, collaborating cross functionally with a multi-season time horizon perspective.

A key member of the product creation team you will support and enable the Manager, Technical Design’s vision on product fit, applying technical know-how in patternmaking construction and precision digital modelling tools transforming product concepts into reality to drive business growth.

How You Will Make a Difference

-
Concept Translation & Technical Realisation: Work closely with the Design and Product Development teams to interpret and translate creative concepts into accurate physical and digital patterns using advanced pattern-making techniques. Leverage CAD and digital pattern tools to create detailed and scalable patterns. Develop digital 3D product samples that enable virtual fittings and iterative adjustments. Utilize 3D modelling software to simulate garment behaviour, ensuring that design intent aligns with technical feasibility and ergonomic performance. Your work will ensure that every idea is effectively translated into products that meet the brand’s strategic and commercial objectives.

-
End-to-End Product Excellence: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine patterns, troubleshoot fit challenges, and implement innovative solutions ensuring that the design intent is accurately realised in every product. Seek manufacturing improvement initiatives with an emphasis on fit and optimal garment performance to ensure they are continually upgraded, enhanced and the best they can be.

-
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise between internal departments (Innovation, Design, Product Development,) and external stakeholders (Vendor base). Establish strong working relationships, facilitate transparent communication and collaboration to ensure seamless integration of design aesthetics with technical precision. Communicate effectively to relay fit issues, propose adjustments, and align on quality benchmarks.

-

The constant pursuit of better is what drives our progress. We're not perfect, but we're looking for solutions that make a positive difference.

Let’s Talk about the Role

Be part of the Global Apparel Product Creation team at icebreaker. The primary responsibilities of the Global Apparel Designer are to conceptualize, design and execute creative projects for the global product and creative department's needs. This includes Men's and Women's apparel.

Utilize design skills to create product that meets expectations in terms of value and cost.

Interact constantly with category team members in development and product management to deliver the appropriate execution for the target consumer audience.

Ensure design practicality and meet merchandising business needs.

Strive to create styles which meet relevant trends, whilst also staying true to brand.

You will be responsible for designing technical apparel using natural fibres.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

-
Support seasonal storytelling and colour direction, by thorough trend, market and competitor research which informs creating mood and concept boards.

-
Work in close partnership with the Product Director, Senior Design manager, Developer, Tech Designer and Merchandiser on the designated category / style.

-
Support in the design, development, approval and usage of all trims.

-
Collaborate with the product development team to ensure style, fit, quality, detail requirements.

-
Meet expectations on accuracy and on-time delivery along product calendar.

-
Facilitate agile decision making on prototype review and revision.

-
Produce thorough tech packs in illustrator with detailed drawings to convey direction for the development team to understand with ease.

Skills for Success

You should be collaborative, flexible, positive and a problem solver, with:

-
Experience: 3-5 years of apparel product design with similar brand(s) or organization(s).

-
Languages: Fluent English essential; additional language is a plus.

-
Portfolio of work which demonstrates; various skills, design and development knowledge, relevancy, and consumer awareness

-
Adobe Creative Suite.

-
Proficiency in 3D Product Creation Software eg: Browswear, CLO.

-
Microsoft Office.

-
Knowledgeable in construction and pattern cutting executions.

-
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast environment and the flexibility to manage and adapt to change.

-
Strong organizational and communication skills.

-
Ability to work within a cross-functional team which supports project management and development.

-
Strong collaboration skills with cross functional teams, finding solutions with the consumer always at forefront of mind.

-
Strong problem-solving skills.

-
Strong attention to detail.

-
Strong presentation skills.

A University Bachelor or Master’s degree in in Fashion / Product Design or equivalent is required.

About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

-
A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

-
An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

-
Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

-
On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

-
A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

-
Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!
